### BIG Pelikan Eraser – Desk Organizer & Storage Container

Turn a classic Pelikan eraser into a fun and original desk organizer!

This 3D model recreates a classic Pelikan eraser in a giant size and is designed as a small multifunctional container for organizing items on your desk.

It is perfect as a small item holder (for example paper clips), desk organizer, or simply as a storage container for keeping stationery and other small objects organized and always within easy reach.

Inspired by the classic Pelikan eraser and traditional school stationery, its design has a vintage and nostalgic look, making it not only useful but also an original decorative item.

Perfect for your desk, office, study room, school or kids' room, it is a fun idea for anyone who loves stationery, oversized objects and creative 3D printed models.

 

Features

* Giant eraser inspired by the classic Pelikan
* Perfect as a desk organizer
* Can be used as a storage container
* Ideal for desk, office and study
* Original gift idea
* No support, No AMS
A simple, recognizable and functional model that transforms a big eraser into an original desk storage organizer!

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.16mm layer, 2 walls, 15% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.16 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PLA (#951E23), PLA (#0078BF), PLA (#FFFFFF)
